metadata.question: Does the surface water extent increase in the area between the Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha in March 16, 2019 compared to March 2018?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about surface water extent changes between March 2018 and March 16, 2019 in the area between the Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha. Key considerations: 1. Location: Area between Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha, Nebraska 2. Time periods: March 2018 vs March 16, 2019 3. Analysis: Compare surface water extent using water detection indices 4. Data: Sentinel-2 would be good for this analysis with its water-sensitive bands Approach: 1. Define the area of interest between the two rivers 2. Use Sentinel-2 imagery for both time periods 3. Calculate MNDWI (Modified Normalized Difference Water Index) for water detection 4. Compare water extent between the two time periods 5. Handle potential data gaps and cloud masking I'll use MNDWI = (Green - SWIR) / (Green + SWIR) which is good for water detection. For Sentinel-2: Green = B3, SWIR = B11 Need to handle: - Cloud masking using QA60 band - Check for empty collections - Validate pixel counts - Compare water extent (pixels with MNDWI > 0) Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define area between Elkhorn and Platte Rivers near Omaha const aoi = ee.Geometry.Polygon([[ [-96.2, 41.1], [-96.0, 41.1], [-96.0, 41.3], [-96.2, 41.3], [-96.2, 41.1] ]]); // Function to mask clouds in Sentinel-2 function maskS2clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } // Function to calculate MNDWI function calculateMNDWI(image) { const mndwi = image.normalizedDifference(['B3', 'B11']).rename('MNDWI'); return image.addBands(mndwi); } // Get March 2018 data const march2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2018-03-01', '2018-03-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(calculateMNDWI) .median(); // Get March 16, 2019 data const march16_2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2019-03-16', '2019-03-16') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)) .map(maskS2clouds) .map(calculateMNDWI) .median(); // Check collection sizes const count2018 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2018-03-01', '2018-03-31') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)) .size(); const count2019 = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(aoi) .filterDate('2019-03-16', '2019-03-16') .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 20)) .size(); const count2018Info = count2018.getInfo(); const count2019Info = count2019.getInfo(); console.log(`March 2018 Images: ${count2018Info} (Cloud<20%)`); console.log(`March 16, 2019 Images: ${count2019Info} (Cloud<20%)`); // Handle empty collections if (count2018Info === 0 || count2019Info === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Calculate water pixels (MNDWI > 0 indicates water) const water2018 = march2018.select('MNDWI').gt(0); const water2019 = march16_2019.select('MNDWI').gt(0); // Count water pixels const waterCount2018 = water2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI'); const waterCount2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(), geometry: aoi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI'); const totalPixels2018 = water2018.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI'); const totalPixels2019 = water2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 100, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('MNDWI'); const water2018Info = waterCount2018.getInfo(); const water2019Info = waterCount2019.getInfo(); const total2018Info = totalPixels2018.getInfo(); const total2019Info = totalPixels2019.getInfo(); console.log(`2018 Water Pixels: ${water2018Info}, Total: ${total2018Info}`); console.log(`2019 Water Pixels: ${water2019Info}, Total: ${total2019Info}`); // Check for no valid pixels if (total2018Info === 0 || total2019Info === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // Check for calculation failures if (water2018Info === null || water2019Info === null || isNaN(water2018Info) || isNaN(water2019Info)) { console.log("C3"); return; } // Calculate water percentages const waterPercent2018 = (water2018Info / total2018Info * 100).toFixed(2); const waterPercent2019 = (water2019Info / total2019Info * 100).toFixed(2); console.log(`2018 Water: ${waterPercent2018}%`); console.log(`2019 Water: ${waterPercent2019}%`); // Determine if water extent increased if (water2019Info > water2018Info) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
